EchoClip Windows FFmpeg build
================================

The Windows package includes an audio-only x86-64 build of:

- FFmpeg 8.1.2: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
- LAME 3.100: https://download.videolan.org/pub/contrib/lame/lame-3.100.tar.gz

The build recipe and exact FFmpeg configure options are stored in:

- scripts/build_windows_ffmpeg.ps1
- third_party/ffmpeg/build-ffmpeg-windows-audio.sh

Networking, video devices, FFplay, and FFprobe are disabled. The build enables
the audio codecs, containers, protocols, and filters used by EchoClip. It does
not use --enable-nonfree.

This build reports "LGPL version 2.1 or later" and does not enable GPL or
nonfree FFmpeg components. LAME 3.100 is licensed under the GNU Library General
Public License version 2 or later. EchoClip is distributed under GPL-3.0-only.
The package includes the applicable FFmpeg and LAME license texts.
Corresponding source is available from the versioned URLs above together with
this repository's build scripts.
